name: Kamat
description: A blunt naga woman of the Tah crop who fights Neit for her heart.

timeline.summary: Gideon learns that crops lose members through the Trials, and Djeru's crop is replacing one lost the day before.
timeline.quote: Many other crops are culled significantly from Trial to Trial, and reformed with others.

timeline.summary: The initiates turn on each other for hearts: Neit kills an initiate, Kamat fights Neit, and Nassor kills Tarik.
timeline.quote: Neit was charging across toward the scales

relations.note: implied by the heart she carries
relations.quote: slippery naga heart clenched in her hands.
